## Public SaaS / website to monitor
Provide only public URLs.

## Evidence you want rechecked over time
Briefly describe the public switching, export, open-interface, termination, fee, or related evidence that matters to your use case.

## What kind of change would be useful to surface?
For example: documentation changed, an export path disappeared, a fee changed, or a public policy page was updated. Keep this non-confidential.

## Timing or review cadence
Optional. This is a preference only; no cadence is committed until scope and terms are agreed.
